text: Adding a dummy for AUM above $150 million to the linear regressions leaves no variable significant at the 5 percent level in March 2012, and the dummy is significant only in April 2012.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416

abstract: We notice that in March 2012, no variable is statistically significant at 5% significance level while in April 2012, the dummy variable is statistically significant.
